brief: A phone charging station: a closed box with a cover that lets a cable pass through.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single full base piece:0,0,0;full enclosed on all 6 side faces with solid end caps (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330) and on top with cover:0,0,0;full;top; check_build shows no OPEN_CAP_FACE issues and meshClash clear

requirements.requirement: Cover that lets a cable pass through
requirements.evidence: Top cover is type cable (cover:0,0,0;full;top stem:cable) which has a cable slot opening, allowing a charging cable to enter the closed box while the box remains closed

requirements.requirement: Phone charging station (usable for a phone)
requirements.evidence: Box footprint 191x169mm and top surface 166x144mm accommodates phone prop (147x72mm) shown on top surface with cable-coil prop routed through cable cover slot; single-cell height 80mm provides enclosed volume for cable/charger

finish.summary: Built a single-cell closed box from one full base, six solid side caps and a top cable cover. The cable cover provides the required cable pass-through while keeping the box closed. Staged with phone and coiled cable on the top surface to show charging use. All faces capped, joints locked, mesh clear.
